messages:
maria: heads up — I want to bump the default route quota for 'cheaper-pool' from 40% -> 60% for a subset of customers. don’t want to flip it live without a safety net. planning: config-preview + telemetry gate + small cohort. :eyes:

alex: sgtm. can the preview API attach a trace id we can query in dashboards? we should avoid a full apply until metrics look stable.

maria: yes — thinking preview with meta {"preview_id": "prv-630012", "enforce": false, "sample_rate": 0.02} so 2% sample during dry-run. snippet below: ```json
{
  "route": "cheaper-pool",
  "weight": 0.6,
  "preview": {"id": "prv-630012", "enforce": false, "sample_rate": 0.02}
}
```

jess: can we gate on per-tenant 95pct latency + error-rate delta + cost-per-token? want to detect both perf regressions and negative $$ impact.

pri: agree. dashboard needs a preview filter. if the preview_id is emitted in request logs we can add a panel: `sum(token_cost) by preview_id` and `p95(latency) by preview_id`. also add a delta view vs baseline.

alex: who owns the alert thresholds? last time we had noisy alerts when sampling was too small. maybe require both a volume floor and a delta threshold: e.g., sample_volume >= 500 requests and p95_delta <= 15% and error_rate_delta <= 0.5pp.

maria: propose runbook: 1) create preview via API 2) wait for sample_volume >= 500 over 30m 3) check panels (p95, error_rate, cost) 4) if all green, promote to a 10% cohort enforce for 30m 5) if still green, gradually scale to 60% commit.

sre-oncall: please include an automatic rollback hook: `apply_with_auto_revert(preview_id, rollback_if=["p95>+25%","err>+1pp","cost>+30%"], window=15m)`. ops playbook needs the exact revert command + who to page.

maria: added. the console UX should show a small badge when a preview is active and expose `promote -> enforce 10% -> scale -> commit` buttons. we need an 'abort' button that calls the revert API.

jess: UI note: show the relevant baseline cohort and link to the comparison trace. also show rolling median and jitter. avoid raw spikes that will scare folks. :+1:

pri: telemetry will emit `preview_id` as tag on metrics, logs, and traces. we'll add an 'is_preview' column in the query layer to simplify charts.

ops-bot: smoke test run for prv-630012: 1) 1k simulated reqs, p95 change +3%, error_rate +0.02pp, cost delta +4%. no alerts fired.

alex: nice. runbook decision: start 2% sample -> 30m -> if volume <500 extend until floor met. otherwise escalate to oncall.

maria: ok let's schedule this for 10:30 PT. tagging @sre-oncall for final runbook ack. :calendar:

sre-oncall: acked. i'll be watching the panels and can trigger `revert_preview(prv-630012)` if thresholds exceeded. pls post the preview id in the incident channel when you start.

jess: quick API question — do we support `preview.scope=tenant_ids` so we can restrict to a deterministic small cohort? deterministic cohorts make comparisons easier.

maria: yes, preview supports `scope: {"tenant_ids": ["t-123","t-456"]}`. for this run we’ll use a sampled global cohort first, then a deterministic 10-tenant cohort before wide rollout.

alex: one more: add a telemetry tag `config_author` so we can filter previews by owner in the dashboard. saves hunting.

maria: good call, will include `meta.owner = maria`.

ops-bot: preview prv-630012 started at 6300123460 by maria.

maria: thanks. will post final notes after 1st 30m check. :thumbsup:
